articles.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
articles.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

articles.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
articles.summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

articles.title: Fair use benefits everyone
articles.summary: OpenAI shares excerpts from court briefs by creators, academics, accessibility advocates, and legal experts, among others, on how fair use supports AI training and innovation.

articles.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
articles.summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

articles.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
articles.summary: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

articles.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
articles.summary: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
